# TECO.md

> TECO.md is a Moldova-based online shop and service provider for video surveillance and security equipment. The business sells equipment and offers installation, configuration, diagnostics, and repair services across the Republic of Moldova.

## Official information

- Website: https://teco.md/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +373 67 200 463
- Email: contact@teco.md
- Business location: Chișinău, Republic of Moldova
- Service coverage: Republic of Moldova. Travel availability, timing, and any travel charge are confirmed for the customer's locality before booking.

## Products and services

- Product catalog, current prices, and stock: https://teco.md/produse/
- Surveillance systems and equipment in Moldova: https://teco.md/camere-supraveghere-moldova/
- Installation and installation pricing: https://teco.md/montare-camere-supraveghere/
- Diagnostics and repair of surveillance cameras, DVR, and NVR: https://teco.md/reparatii-camere-supraveghere/
- Services: https://teco.md/servicii/
- Delivery information: https://teco.md/livrare/
- Contact and quote requests: https://teco.md/contact/

## Requesting a quote

For an installation quote, provide the locality anywhere in Moldova, the type of property, approximate number of cameras, and photos or a sketch of the areas to cover. TECO.md can then confirm equipment, installation scope, travel availability, timing, and the price for that address.

Product prices and availability can change. Use the relevant live product page or ask TECO.md to confirm before ordering. Installation and travel are included only when they are explicitly listed in the quote.

## Language

The website provides information in Romanian and Russian.
